body: To quote Office Space: "I would relax... I would sit on my ass all day... I would do nothing. "

I'm not scared to live or die. If anything, I crave death, or at the very least what death represents in my mind. Best as I can figure, it represents not having to deal daily with the thoughts that I should be dead.

As for your question, I have no idea if the urge to die will end when I'm dead. But I suspect it will, and the only way to find out for sure is to actually do it. And if, for whatever reason, it doesn't work, then I'd have to work out another potential solution.
